result.quote: Then the old prophet instructed his sons, “Saddle the donkey for me.” So they saddled it,
result.reason: The key assigns the saddling to the old prophet, but he only instructs his sons; they saddle the donkey. He then goes and finds the body. Also, “after hearing men” is unclear and not stated in the window, which only says he “heard this.” A supported answer would be: “He told his sons to saddle the donkey, then went and found the body.”
